knowledge:
- key_parameters: datadir=Directory containing the hybridization files (defaults to current directory ".") ;; pat=File extension pattern to search for (defaults to "gpr") ;; intensityCutoff=Threshold below which intensities are set to NA in correctForFlags() to avoid near-background false positives ;; minSumlength=Minimum number of present values required to accept a summarized feature in summarizeIntensitiesAsMedian() ;; madAdjust=Logical; if TRUE, sets summarized intensities to NA if the median absolute deviation is greater than the median intensity
- alternatives: The package parses data into a standard Bioconductor ExpressionSet, allowing users to easily substitute the built-in median normalization with other normalization methods available in Bioconductor (e.g., limma or affy)
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing single-color Cy3 hybridization miRNA expression data generated from the MiChip microarray platform and gridded using GenePix software
- pitfalls: All hybridization files in the target directory must be of the same chip type, otherwise parseRawData() will throw an error ;; positive but low intensities near background can lead to false positives; use the intensityCutoff parameter in correctForFlags() to filter these out ;; highly variable replicate spots can skew results; set madAdjust=TRUE in summarizeIntensitiesAsMedian() to handle them

workflows.name: step_by_step_processing
workflows.intent: Manually parse, filter, flag-correct, summarize, plot, normalize, and export MiChip miRNA microarray data step-by-step.
workflows.stages: 1. Parse raw data ;; 2. Filter out empty and unwanted rows ;; 3. Correct for bad flags and low-intensity background ;; 4. Summarize replicate spot intensities ;; 5. Generate diagnostic scatter and box plots ;; 6. Perform per-chip median normalization ;; 7. Export the annotated normalized data matrix
workflows.code:
library(MiChip)
datadir <-system.file("extdata", package="MiChip")
defaultRawData <- parseRawData(datadir)
noEmptiesDataSet <- removeUnwantedRows(defaultRawData, c("Empty"))
humanDataSet <- standardRemoveRows(defaultRawData)
flagCorrectedDataSet <- correctForFlags(humanDataSet)
flagCorrectedDataSet <- correctForFlags(humanDataSet, intensityCutoff = 50)
summedData <- summarizeIntensitiesAsMedian(flagCorrectedDataSet,minSumlength = 0, madAdjust=FALSE)
plotIntensitiesScatter(exprs(summedData), NULL, "MiChipDemX", "SummarizedScatter")
boxplotData(exprs(summedData), "MiChipDemX", "Summarized")
mednormedData <- normalizePerChipMedian(summedData)
outputAnnotatedDataMatrix(mednormedData, "MiChipDemo", "medNormedIntensity",  "exprs")

workflows.name: automated_pipeline
workflows.intent: Run an automated, all-in-one pipeline that parses, filters, corrects, normalizes, and exports MiChip data and diagnostic plots using a single wrapper function.
workflows.stages: 1. Execute the automated wrapper function to process files and output results/plots to the working directory
